description: Defines the class 'FieldUiLocalTask' which provides local task definitions for entity bundles in Drupal's field_ui module, including methods for generating derivative definitions and altering local tasks based on entity types, form modes, and view modes.

classes.name: FieldUiLocalTask
classes.description: Provides local task definitions for all entity bundles, managing derivative definitions and local task alterations for entity field UI in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies: route provider, entity type manager, string translation, and entity display repository.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class using the container to get dependencies.

methods.name: getDerivativeDefinitions
methods.description: Generates derivative definitions for local tasks based on entity types, including tabs for managing fields, form display, display, editing, and view modes.

methods.name: alterLocalTasks
methods.description: Modifies existing local task definitions to set the correct base route for each entity type's field UI related tasks.
